old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ly9b","title":"C/Rust SCHC compress profile-limit divergence: C bounds raw packet, Rust bounds encoded output","description":"P1 cross-implementation contract divergence exposed by project-LICHEN-worker6-gswp. Empirical: raw = 22555 rule5-shaped -\u003e C returns SCHC_ERR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL, Rust accepts Ok(22526). Opposite verdicts in the band raw in (22554, 22583]. spec/03 does not state explicitly whether the 22554 ceiling bounds the raw packet or the encoded form. Needs a tracked spec decision, then fix ONE implementation + its tests on both sides; until then the band is an interop hazard (same wire input, opposite verdicts).
